owner.name: Nate Cordero
owner.bio: Nate Cordero started running wire as an apprentice on new-construction crews around the Treasure Valley, then moved into service work — the calls where something's already broken and somebody's waiting on you to fix it. Voltridge Electric is the one-van operation he always wanted: he answers his own phone, quotes the job before he starts, and doesn't leave a panel looking like a spider built it.

services.title: Panel Upgrades
services.desc: Old fuse box or a panel maxed out on double-taps and no room left? We swap it for a modern panel sized for how much power your house actually uses now.

services.title: EV Charger Install
services.desc: A dedicated circuit and a Level 2 charger, wired so your car charges overnight without tripping anything else in the house.

services.title: Lighting & Fixtures
services.desc: Recessed lighting, ceiling fans, outdoor security lights, dimmer upgrades — wired clean, no exposed junction boxes left behind.

services.title: Troubleshooting & Repairs
services.desc: Flickering lights, dead outlets, breakers that trip for no reason — we find the actual cause, not just the symptom.

services.title: Generator Hookups
services.desc: A transfer switch and generator hookup so a storm outage doesn't mean sitting in the dark.

services.title: Smart Home Wiring
services.desc: Smart switches, smart panels, EV-ready circuits — wired for what your house does now and what it does in five years.

faq.a: Yes — any job that requires one gets a permit pulled and inspected. It's part of doing it right, not an upsell.

faq.q: How do I know if my panel needs an upgrade?
faq.a: Breakers that trip for no clear reason, warm or discolored outlets, flickering lights when something big kicks on, or a fuse box instead of breakers — any of those is worth a look.

faq.q: How long does an EV charger install take?
faq.a: Most installs are same-day — usually two to four hours once we're on site, depending on how far the panel is from where the charger goes.
For active hazards — sparking, burning smell, a dead panel — yes, call and we'll work you in. Routine issues get scheduled at the next normal slot.

faq.q: Is the service call fee separate from the repair cost?
faq.a: The service call covers the first hour of diagnostic time. If you move forward with the repair that day, it's applied toward the total — you're not paying twice.

serviceCall.note: First-hour diagnostic — applied toward the repair if you move forward that day.
